conditional_covariate_rationale.A: BMI and clinically defined sleep apnea are the smallest directly justified set for testing adiposity and sleep-disordered-breathing explanations of snoring-lifespan local sharing.
conditional_covariate_rationale.B: Major depressive disorder is the single predeclared broad psychiatric competing architecture for insomnia-ADHD; adding metabolic, smoking, and vascular traits without a locus-specific rationale would overcondition.
conditional_covariate_rationale.CONTROL: The positive control is used for pipeline concordance and has no predeclared conditional headline test.

local_method_robustness.execution_rule: Use an ancestry-matched independently implemented local method only when its reference and software pass provenance gates; do not substitute overlapping peaks for a robustness result.

reference: LAVA UK Biobank European v1.1 100000-person LD reference
conditional_execution_gate: Run partial local genetic correlation only for primary bivariate rows passing Track B BH FDR<=0.05 and only when every predeclared conditioner passes the same locus-level univariate threshold
conditional_multiple_testing: BH FDR across all successfully tested conditional rows for the frozen A and B covariate sets
